resolve_file_env: resolve an environment variable with Docker-secrets _FILE support from the open_terminal.env module
read_api_key: read the API_KEY constant resolved from OPEN_TERMINAL_API_KEY env var or config file in open_terminal.env
read_cors_origins: read the CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS constant from OPEN_TERMINAL_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var or config in open_terminal.env
read_log_dir: read the LOG_DIR constant from OPEN_TERMINAL_LOG_DIR env var or config in open_terminal.env
read_max_terminal_sessions: read the MAX_TERMINAL_SESSIONS integer constant from OPEN_TERMINAL_MAX_SESSIONS env var or config in open_terminal.env
